# What's new in 0.3.0

Released **2026-10-02**. Full project history: [CHANGELOG.md](../../CHANGELOG.md).

## Highlights

- **steadyGrind UI** — light cool-blue theme, Public Sans, home with Today profile chart, Manual watt stepper, and Library table
- **Autoconnect** — when enabled, reconnects to a Real KICKR when it appears on the LAN (Disconnect pauses until you Connect again)
- **Ride flow** — timer only advances with cadence; auto-pause when you stop pedaling; in-app stop summary (elapsed + avg watts)
- **Workout preview** — power profile chart (zone colours + FTP line) instead of a stage table; tap a stage for details
- Start buttons stay disabled until the trainer or Emulator is connected
- macOS packaging runs unit + UI e2e tests before building the DMG

## Installer

- `KICKR-Pi-0.3.0-macos.dmg` (this folder)
- GitHub Release: https://github.com/attilameget/HomeWlanTrainer/releases/tag/v0.3.0
